notes.title: 1.1.7 - Lots of bug fixes + QoL changes
notes.content:
Back with another update! In terms of the amount of fixes and adjustments, this might be one of our biggest patches yet. 

We recruited the help of a fan and modder, Buttery Stancakes, to help us do some very extensive QA. Their knowledge of the game and attention to detail was extremely vital for helping us iron out a lot of remaining bugs and general polish issues with the game. There's a lot of stuff here that *most* people probably would not notice, but they make a big impact on the game's overall quality.

Here are more thorough notes on what's been fixed/changed:


Bear traps should now disappear after you “escape” from them
Fixed issue with fog effect, where you could "peak through the fog" if you rotated the camera a certain way
Fixed bug where a specific destroyed camera could still detect the player after loading a save file
Fixed bug where the "ambient light" would reset if you touched some specific triggers
Fixed bug where the Revolver cylinder could go out of order if you shot continuously
Disabled some useless items during a later section of the game
Fixed issue where you could reload the gun while swimming
Fixed bug where Paperclip health would persist when starting a new game
Fixed bug where certain light sources did not correctly increase the player's illumination
Fixed issue where you could destroy some doorknobs during a segment you weren't meant to (sorry to any speedrunners)
Fixed bug where using the Hammer to destroy things wouldn't correctly alert the Butcher
Fixed an animation issue that could occur when using the Hammer for a puzzle segment
Fixed a long-standing "inventory" bug where you could get an invisible duplicate item in your inventory
Fixed a NavMesh carver issue
Fixed some audio ambience
Added low pass filter to Radar item, so the high pitch sound should be less bothersome for players
Adjusted Butcher costume changes slightly
Fixed bug where item illumination didn't correctly update when dropping items
Fixed issue with lock picking on keyboard, where you can *now* use both A and D to rotate the lockpick
Fixed bug where solving a specific puzzle would cause Granny to scream
Adjusted Health indicator so it makes more sense with the current damage values, and should better reflect how many hits are left before you die
Fixed issue where photo mode movement speed was framerate dependent
Adjusted a "blood" texture on a couple specific models
Fixed issue with TV framerate
Fixed clock puzzle being framerate-dependant
Fixed some visual issues with swimming
Fixed some visual issues with the Oxygen Meter
Fixed issue where baby would ignore damage after retreating for first time
Fixed a couple paperclips that were impossible to grab
Fixed bug where some items were incorrectly parents to cabinet doors
Fixed minor bug where a specific item did not have a "visual flare"
Fixed issue with Butcher AI related to seeing the player in vents
Adjusted behavior related to Butcher's "flashlight"
Fixed some issues related to Bug Spray item particles
Adjusted some "reskin" textures for specific items
Using water canteen or candy bar while your stats are at 100% will now trigger the "I don't need to use this" text
Fixed some rotation + hand position values of specific items
Fixed issue related to "Chainsaw Damage" being incorrect on some difficulties
The first screwdriver has its position slightly changed so its more obvious
Fixed some cabinet collision issues
Got rid of some unnecessary "bolt locks"
Adjusted position of exhaust fan
Adjusted a specific NPC's clothing
Fixed issue where you could interact with a specific puzzle from a very far distance
Fixed bug where running out of Oxygen on Easy wouldn't kill you
You can destroy TVs in 1 hit with the hammer now
A couple "permanent" lights were disabled
Fixed issue where some characters were slower on Easy mode when they shouldn't have been
Adjusted "blood loss" on Hard mode
Adjusted door physics slightly
Fixed some Dog AI issues
Adjusted issue related to Clock puzzle when you save + load a game
Fixed bug where Stamina drain rate was incorrect
Fixed bug where Victim could endlessly scream
Fixed bug where documents could get duplicated
Fixed issue related to the lightbulbs in the basement
Fixed softlock that could happen if you interacted with a specific HVAC fan from a far enough distance away
Fixed a couple issues related to item spawn locations
Fixed issue where you could drop items when they weren't mean to be dropped, which would lead to them falling out of bounds
Fixed issue where "no longer needed" items would drop during a puzzle segment, and then fall out of bounds
Adjusted minor camera movement when doing a specific puzzle
Fixed issue with radar blips appearing outside of the radar screen
Fixed issue where enemies could open a specific door when they walked by it
Fixed an exploit during the "final segment" where the player could easily avoid damage
Fixed bug related to exiting water while their was still gas in the vents
Victims stand up when they are in the safe room
Properly gated off specific sections of the game during an "escape sequence"
Fixed bug where the Language Prompt would always appear
Fixed issue where you FOV would reset after interacting with certain puzzles
Fixed bug where dying to Fall Damage during the "final segment" would not correctly reset the game state
Fixed bug where a specific survivor would repeat their dialogue
Adjusted resolution options
Fixed bug where the pause screen would bug out if you paused at just the right time


That should be it! Thanks everyone for your patience and support of the game!

notes.title: New Languages, Mac release and more!
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

We have some exciting news to share with you all today. We've just released a big update for Stay Out of the House! Here's what you can expect:

New Languages: 
Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, French

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33609626/4ef700f2f8cfc689df0aebaa3939d62984de941f.gif

We're thrilled to announce that we've added support for five new languages to the game. This means that players from all over the world can now enjoy Stay Out of the House in their native language. We understand that language can be a significant barrier for some players, and we want to make sure everyone can enjoy the game regardless of their language proficiency. So, whether you're a native speaker or learning a new language, we hope you enjoy the new languages.


Mac Build is now on Steam!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33609626/1e5bf713cb358cab4a2c46bbb1da76cca811156b.gif

We've also added support for Mac users who play on Steam. Previously, Stay Out of the House was only available on PC, but now Mac users can join in on the fun too. We hope this will encourage even more players to try out the game and see if they can survive the horrors that lurk within the house.

Cloud Saves Added so you can play anywhere!

Finally, we're excited to announce that cloud saves have been added to the game. This means that you can now save your progress and play the game on any device. No more worrying about losing progress when you switch devices or play on the go. Cloud saves make it easy to pick up right where you left off, whether you're at home or on the move.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33609626/ac9597de357329933e41949ddf2c974a52d4702a.gif

We hope you enjoy the latest update to Stay Out of the House. As always, we're grateful for your support and feedback. If you have any questions or comments, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. Happy surviving!

notes.title: Content Update - Hard Mode, Explore Mode, and more changes
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I have a proper content update this time. Hope you all enjoy. Here's what you can expect:

Major Additions

Hard Mode. You have additional "survival mechanics" to manage, like hunger, thirst, and bleeding. There are a couple new items/interactions to let you deal with these new systems. There's also fall damage on this mode, and the Butcher is a bit more aware of you.
Explore Mode. You can now playthrough the game without having to deal with any hostile characters. Some scripted sequences involving hostile characters will still play out as normal though.
Document Viewer. Available from the Inventory screen, you can view any document you had seen before. Useful for tracking the investigator achievement, or for double checking a puzzle code.
The Hammer can now also be used as a defensive weapon. It's the slowest melee weapon.
There is a new secret achievement to unlock
Bug Spray item can be used to make the Butcher retreat
You can trap the Butcher and Dog in a specific room... if you're quick enough. Doing so can also skip an event with the Butcher near the end of the game.
Using the VHS or 16mm video setting with make the voice acting lo-fi
"Text over FX" setting lets any text and certain UI elements readable even if you have a video effect enabled
High Pitch Sounds setting lets you disable/enable any high pitched sound effects


QoL and Bug Fixes

Fixed issue where you could take out the nails on a floor board from the wrong side
Fixed issue where the player could double-back to the House after going through a scripted ending sequence
Control prompt appears when interacting with the Clock Puzzle
Certain items (Drain Cleaner, Rubbing alcohol) become unusable once they served their purpose
You can alternatively unlock the Hero achievement by leading a Victim through the front door
You can kill Rats with the Knife
You cannot use Bandages if you are already at full health
Fixed issue where victim's dead bodies could get frozen in the air
Fixed issue where the ending hospital scene was too dark
Fixed a couple cases where using "RT" on a controller would skip past dialogue too quickly
Fixed issue where picking up and dropping the wooden plank could sometimes make the wooden plank huge in scale
Fixed a couple buggy interactions with the Crippled Woman
Fixed bug where if you made the Butcher retreat while he was killing a victim, the victim's screams wouldn't stop
Fixed visual issue where a puzzle prompt didn't appear visible at first
Fixed issue where Roxanne's voice was lower than it should've been
Fixed issue where if you were crouched you wouldn't be able to stand, in a very specific location
Fixed some AI issues related to the Dog
Fixed a couple "floating" objects
Fixed bug where Butcher would walk through the Fridge in the Kitchen
Fixed some radar issues


That's it! Thanks for playing STAY OUT OF THE HOUSE!

notes.title: Stay out of the House Halloween Update
notes.content:
First of all I want to thank everyone for picking up the game. I hope you've enjoyed it.

Stay out of the House is in much better shape now. Lum and I have been working our asses off. The bugs are almost all fixed and things are pretty stable. If you had issues before, you should be safe giving it another shot this Halloween.

I apologize for the launch. It was a shame working on a game for almost 5 years and then botching the release in the worst way possible with multiple delays and then bugs. We actually did more testing than any other Puppet Combo game with 10 testers on the payroll. But the sandbox-y nature of everything hid some bugs we didn't expect once it hit the public. Not to mention some engine issues that were totally unexpected but bricked the game for a small number of gamers. I hope everyone feels satisfied with their purchase now or got a refund if you didn't want to wait for patches.

It hasn't done the great commercially with almost no media coverage or reviews but I'm confident the game's reputation will grow over time. Please leave a review if you have time, those really help!

But aside from the struggles, I'm proud of what was accomplished. The game has turned out exactly how I envisioned it. I know it's not a game for everyone but I think it's find it's audience over the years. Huge thanks to you guys for supporting it from the start.

Happy Halloween Everyone!

notes.title: What else would you like to see in the game?
notes.content:
I'm thinking about things to add to Stay out of the House to make it better. Here are some ideas I have in mind. Let me know yours as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33609626/dbbfd52793dc63a60ceba1ef04c090b25f6debbf.jpg

Butcher AI improvements

In the current version of the game, the butcher mostly walks around the house searching for you. That works fine but I'd like to make improvements. Most specifically by giving the butcher new behaviors or a routine that he does on his own. 

His main task is to keep the meat supply flowing by grabbing victims from the yard, dismembering them, and carting the meat into the basement. Since he'll be busy in the kitchen, he should be easier to avoid as long as you don't screw up and the house is in a normal state.

To offset the lack of butcher patrols, I was thinking of adding a security camera that can eventually be disabled. If you are spotted and escape, the butcher will search for you until he captures you, locking you in a new cell for the start of another day.

Each day will get harder as he installs more security: he'll fix the camera you disabled and add another one. Maybe add more locks to the door. Granny will spawn on the map, etc.

If you kill Granny he'll go into a rage, turn the gas on, and flip over all the beds looking for you relentlessly. He'll also release the mutant which can get inside the vents and hunt you.

Ideally, I'd like to do a Resident Evil style save system - possibly with save items but the main idea being, you can only save at a specific safe point on the map. However, if you're captured, the game will auto save, starting you inside your new cell - permanent punishment for failure. And if you die, your save is wiped out completely.

Other things I'd like to add:

More ammo. Not too much though.
A melee weapon to use.
An inventory space upgrade as you progress. Maybe 6 items you can carry instead of 3
A third ending.
Boss fight with the butcher


Let me know if you have more ideas.

notes.title: SOOTH Update July
notes.content:
Hope you're having a great summer! Stay out of the House is content complete now. 0.7.2 is the latest version.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33609626/a9105f6c37a4091012867f77cf060c5385ed0c8b.gif

What's been added:

 A new prologue (so the title of the game is actually a plot point in the game)
 A alternative ending. So there are two routes to choose. Do you escape the house, or go deeper to uncover the butcher's dark secret.
 New cutscenes and story events as you progress.
 A dangerous new character.
 New fleshly props and human remains for a more lurid atmosphere.
 Various bug fixes and improvements.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33609626/9bdb68fe6a7d5a0904c493eaa591c9437fadf741.jpg

The big question now is, what still needs to be added before I can release the game?


 Combining Night Shift, Stay out of the House and Nun Massacre into one executable, or splitting Nun Massacre into a separate title in your library (or free dlc?). The api is complicated and I still have trouble wrapping my head around it.
 Full controller support. The difficult part with controller support is making the Ui work. 
 Save system or checkpoints. Another thing more difficult than it sounds because there are a lot of things in the game that need to be tracked and saved and I may need to recode a lot of things to make it work. I'm not totally sure yet. I'm optimistic I can accomplish this with minimal refactoring, but I won't know until I start.
 Options and menus.
 Steam integrations. 


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33609626/3a0b312b3d2217ab1f55c7e722de6182b3fd06fa.jpg

So that's where the game is right now. I hope it will be done soon, but I can't accurately estimate when it will come out on steam.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33609626/e94d30c736103feaf43e5269834c4105adec6f91.gif

notes.title: Stay out of the House update - when is it coming out?
notes.content:
Hope you guys had a great Thanksgiving!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33609626/3cabf065696ae74cd95890746fa8286a2951f2a3.gif

Here's a very late Stay out of the House update. As you guys know, I intended to have it out before Halloween, but I ran out of time and underestimated what it would take to finish.

I take the Steam release very seriously and I want to make sure the game is 100% ready before I start selling it at full price. I think a perfect but delayed release is far better than rushed out and patched later.

All the story content will be finished this month and downloadable for anyone who has early access through a pre-order or my patreon. Meaning all the puzzles along with the endings.So the game will be fully playable.

But a fully polished release requires more than that: controller support, configuration options, full optimization, achievements, trading cards. So I'm holding it back until that stuff is done.

My best estimate for release is after the holidays when things calm down a bit. Probably January. If you're dying to play it in the meantime, the DRM free early access version is on my website at 1/3 of the full release price. So don't hesitate to pick it up there if you can overlook some of the unpolished features. And you'll get the key when the full version comes out.
